The '''LCS 2019 Spring''' was the first split of the 2019 [[League of Legends Championship Series]] (LCS), organized by Riot Games. It took place from January 26 to April 13, 2019, with the regular season held at the NA LCS Studio in Los Angeles and the Playoffs concluding in St. Louis, United States held in the Chaifetz Arena. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage ({{Abbr/Bo1}}), followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket ({{Abbr/Bo5}}). The winner qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|2019 Mid-Season Invitational]], and the top three teams earned spots at [[Rift Rivals/NA-EU/2019|Rift Rivals 2019 NA-EU]].

The split was played on patch 9.1 with an updated patch 9.6 used in later matches. The format awarded Championship Points based on final placement, and prize money totaled $200,000 USD.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' - ''January 26th - March 24th, 2019''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of Playoffs.
*** 1st place team from Group Stage will select their opponent from Quarterfinals
*** 2nd place team from Group Stage will face the remaining team from Quarterfinals
* '''Playoffs''' - ''March 30th - April 13th, 2019''
** Single Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} 
** Top 3 qualify for [[Rift Rivals/NA-EU/2019|Rift Rivals 2019 NA-EU]]
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2019|Mid-Season Invitational 2019]]
